verdict.rationale: The Comptroller publishes its own data as machine-readable raw datasets. A keyless probe confirmed that its Active Franchise Tax Permit Holders dataset returns structured JSON through a SODA query on data.texas.gov. That gives an agent a real, though read-only, programmatic rail for registration status. It cannot drive the core product: Webfile filing and payment sit only behind an authenticated eSystems session, no OpenAPI spec exists at any probed path, and EDI is mentioned only as a high-volume business channel with no public API documentation. Missing for 10: a documented public API for filing, payments and account actions (extensions, certificates, address changes); an OpenAPI or other API reference; an authenticated programmatic access path; publicly documented EDI specs.
